hero_heading: We build brands pixel by pixel.
hero_sub: Pixcel Studio is a small design house crafting identities, packaging and social content for brands that want to look impossible to ignore.
about_body: We're a four-person studio based between Hyderabad and remote. We don't do templates or trend-chasing — every project starts from the brand's own material, not a moodboard we already had lying around. Small team, short chains of command, work you can actually point to.
contact_body: Tell us what you're building and we'll get back within two working days.
footer_note: Pixcel Studio. Branding, packaging and social design.
